properties.value:
– How to manage conflicts between doing good and doing well

How can you overcome dilemmas between sustainability and business? How do you avoid being hit by a CSR crisis and what to do when the watchdog bites? 

At our miniconference on the 29th of November 2016 we explored some of the complex dilemmas companies are facing when doing good and doing well and got inspired by how real-life cases succeed in managing CSR crises.

Watch this intro video to get insights from Tania Ellis, Dell, PKA and Danske Spil.
